adversarial_findings.title: N-HEAL-04 parallel vulnerability: KDS startAutoRefresh has cadence captured at startup + no isStale fallback
adversarial_findings.evidence: this.autoRefreshInterval = setInterval(..., this._pollingInterval()); — _pollingInterval() returns wsConnected?60000:5000. Cadence frozen at construction time. Only _restartPolling on WS state_change can update it. Silent Echo failure (channel-auth fail with persistent socket) leaves cadence stuck at 60s.
adversarial_findings.n_heal_04_analog: Same structural bug N-HEAL-04 healed in PosComponent. KDS lacks the isEmpty/isStale fallback that PosComponent._kioskPollingInterval introduced (PosComponent.vue:2616-2630).
adversarial_findings.impact: Kitchen staleness budget (5s target) silently breached when Echo subscription drops without WS disconnect. Orders not surfacing within 5s of payment.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Refactor startAutoRefresh to self-recursive setTimeout + add isStale fallback comparing now() vs last successful refreshOrderList timestamp.
adversarial_findings.primary_path_kds_sync_mitigation: KdsSyncService is the canonical sync path for KDS V2 (uses self-recursive setTimeout with cadence recompute on WS state change + 5xx backoff). Legacy startAutoRefresh is a SECONDARY fallback. Risk is therefore lower than for PosComponent (which is primary path) but still present whenever the legacy KDS path is active.

adversarial_findings.title: N-HEAL-04 parallel vulnerability: PosOrdersTrackerComponent _startPolling has cadence captured at startup + no isStale fallback
adversarial_findings.evidence: this._pollTimer = setInterval(() => this.fetchOrders(), this._pollInterval()); — _pollInterval() returns realtimeConnected?POLL_WS_MS:POLL_NO_WS_MS (60000 vs 8000). Cadence frozen at construction time. Only _restartPolling on WS state_change can update it. Silent Echo failure leaves cadence stuck at 60s.
adversarial_findings.n_heal_04_analog: Same structural bug N-HEAL-04 healed in PosComponent. No isStale fallback.
adversarial_findings.impact: POS tracker dashboard widget (across PaymentComponent + PosOrdersTrackerComponent + ReceiptComponent) shows stale order list if Echo channel-auth silently fails. Cashier sees orders linger after they should be cleared.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Refactor _startPolling to self-recursive setTimeout pattern matching N-HEAL-04; add timestamp-based isStale fallback in _pollInterval().

adversarial_findings.title: Most legacy polling loops lack explicit in-flight back-pressure guard
adversarial_findings.evidence: Only KioskWaitingComponent._doPoll (line 300 _pollInFlight) has explicit overlap guard. PosOrdersTracker, KDS legacy, Outbox, StockRupture, PaymentComponent, KioskPayment all rely on cadence > realistic round-trip — but no enforcement if endpoint slows.
adversarial_findings.scenario: Backend endpoint slows >60s (DB lock, queue saturation) → next setInterval tick fires while previous request still in flight → request pile-up amplifies the load on the slow endpoint.
adversarial_findings.mitigation_partial: Sync services (KdsSync/PosSync/OssSync) all use AbortController. The 4 self-recursive setTimeout patterns implicitly serialize (next tick scheduled only after await completes).
adversarial_findings.remediation: Migrate legacy setInterval loops to self-recursive setTimeout pattern (which inherently serializes), or add explicit _inFlight guard.

adversarial_findings.title: Browser-throttled setTimeout when laptop lid closes (offline polling)
adversarial_findings.evidence: Browsers throttle setInterval/setTimeout to ~1s when tab backgrounded, may pause entirely when laptop sleeps. On wake, all timers fire near-simultaneously creating a request burst.
adversarial_findings.mitigation: OssSyncService line 218-225 has explicit visibilitychange burst-poll on visible. PosSyncService line 343 _scheduleNormalCadence has jitter (0-500ms). KdsSyncService has 0-jitter for forceSync.
adversarial_findings.gap: PosComponent _kioskPollingInterval has no visibilitychange burst-poll; relies on Echo reconnect handler (PosComponent.vue:2598-2608) which only fires if WS truly disconnected during sleep.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Add visibilitychange listener in PosComponent.mounted that forces a single loadKioskCashOrders/loadReadyOrders + restartKioskPolling cycle when document becomes visible. Mirror OssSyncService pattern.

adversarial_findings.title: Polling endpoint error: no max-retry circuit-breaker for legacy intervals
adversarial_findings.evidence: KioskWaitingComponent line 327-331 counts pollFailCount and surfaces 'networkLost' banner after 3 failures, but continues polling forever. OutboxOverview, StockRupture, PosOrdersTracker, KDS legacy all swallow errors silently and keep polling.
adversarial_findings.scenario: Server returns 500 on every poll for hours → frontend keeps hammering at full cadence. KdsSyncService + PosSyncService + OssSyncService have proper 5xx backoff doubling (cap 30s). Legacy loops do not.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Either: (a) add 5xx backoff doubling to legacy intervals; (b) migrate to sync-service primary paths and deprecate the parallel legacy loops.

adversarial_findings.title: Long-session memory growth from accumulated AbortControllers / promise chains
adversarial_findings.evidence: 4h+ cashier shifts with 60s polling = 240 ticks. Each Echo handler + each fetchOrders allocates closures. PosComponent._availabilityToastTimers (line 2059) explicit cleanup pattern is best practice but not universal.
adversarial_findings.mitigation: All identified polling loops have beforeUnmount cleanup. Sync services have abort+state-machine teardown.
adversarial_findings.remaining_concern: Long-session Vuex store growth (orderStatusScreenOrder/lists accumulates fetched orders) - out of scope for polling cadence audit.

verdict_rationale: Primary kiosk-ready polling (PosComponent N-HEAL-04) is GREEN — self-recursive setTimeout + isStale/isEmpty fallback + sentinel lock. Sync services (Kds/Pos/Oss) are GREEN — self-recursive setTimeout + WS-state subscriptions + AbortController back-pressure + 5xx backoff. However, two N-HEAL-04 structural twins remain: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.startAutoRefresh and PosOrdersTrackerComponent._startPolling both use setInterval with cadence captured at startup and lack the isStale fallback. Both are vulnerable to the exact silent-Echo failure mode N-HEAL-04 documents (channel-auth fail with persistent WS socket). KDS risk is lower because KdsSyncService is the primary sync path (V2 KDS); legacy startAutoRefresh is fallback. POS tracker risk is more direct — it is the canonical path for the cashier-facing PosOrdersTrackerComponent surface. RECOMMENDATION: extend N-HEAL-04 refactor to both sites in a follow-up Z8-FOLLOWUP wave (small surgical patch, no frozen-zone, mirror sentinel pattern).
